text:
marie: FYI opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/492 — clarifies tiered rate limits, documents burst credits behavior, and adds a per-route Grafana panel snippet. Need quick review before EOD. :hourglass:

josh: taking a look. quick q — are we standardizing on the term 'burst credits' or 'burst behavior'? product has used both.

marie: Product confirmed 'burst credits' is the Console/UX label. I added a parenthetical 'aka burst behavior' in the intro for folks coming from older docs. Also included an SDK snippet for reading limit headers.

alan: paste the snippet here so I can sanity-check header names and casing before merging.

marie: snippet in PR comment:```js
// read rate limit headers from fetch response
const res = await fetch('/v1/responses');
console.log(res.headers.get('rate-limit-remaining'));
console.log(res.headers.get('rate-limit-reset'));
```

priya: note on the Grafana JSON: you hardcoded `us-west1` in the dashboard vars. Please switch to `$env_region` so customers can preview other regions. And change panel title to clarify "per-route" vs "per-key" aggregation.

josh: CI preview showed `/images/quota-heatmap.png` 404 in the docs site.

marie: fixed the image path and pushed a commit. @deploy-bot can you re-run docs CI?

deploy-bot: CI queued: docs-lint, linkcheck, grafana-validate.

docs-bot: docs-lint failed on PR 492 — missing fenced language on two code blocks (approx lines 104 and 201). See logs.

simon: I'll handle the lint fixes. Also, please add a migration callout showing mapping from legacy headers to new ones: legacy `x-rate-limit-*` -> new `rate-limit-*`. We changed naming in infra in 2025 and older SDKs will show the old names.

alan: agreed. add explicit example mapping and mention both names are currently supported but legacy will be removed in a future release.

marie: added migration callout and toggled Grafana JSON to use `$env_region`. Also fixed code fence language tags. Pushed.

priya: LGTM content-wise. One nit: change panel subtitle from "Usage" to "Usage (tokens/min)" so units are explicit. After that I'll approve.

josh: image renders in preview now. Approving once Priya approves. :thumbsup:

marie: merged PR and updated release notes. Merge commit at 1865440024. Closing thread. :tada:
